settings.label: Support email
settings.info: Shown on the page as the contact for questions and reactions (US cosmetic adverse-event contact). Use a monitored address.

settings.label: Logo (optional)
settings.info: Upload only images you own or have licensed. No supplier/competitor photos. Before/after only from real, consenting customers, unedited.

settings.content: Palette (day look; the night look uses ink, sand and lilac automatically)

settings.label: Teal (icons, borders, large text only)
settings.info: White text on this teal is about 3.3:1 and fails AA. Never use it for normal-size text.

settings.label: Teal deep (links, small text, selected states)
settings.info: Passes AA for text on sand and white.

settings.label: Apricot (primary button; text on it is ink)
Hero product
settings.info: One change here rebinds the whole landing page. The product page for this product canonicalises to the homepage.

settings.label: Preselected pack (position in the variant list)
settings.info: 1 = first variant, 2 = second (the Stash), 3 = third. A ?variant=ID in the URL overrides it.

settings.content: Delivery estimate (business days, shown as a date range)

settings.label: Guarantee line
settings.info: Must match your real return policy.

settings.label: Free-shipping threshold
settings.info: Used for the free-shipping line, the cart progress bar and delivery copy. Set to 0 to hide. Free shipping itself is configured in Shopify shipping settings.

settings.label: Upsell fallback collection
settings.info: Used when Shopify has no complementary recommendations yet.
